description: This file is a shell script designed for testing behaviors of git packfile repacking, specifically focusing on delta compression, island strategies, and packfile ordering. It includes functions to set up commits and check delta bases, as well as a series of test cases to validate various packing scenarios.

methods.name: is_delta_base
methods.description: Checks whether a given object is a delta based on a specified base object.

methods.name: commit
methods.description: Creates a new commit with a blob that is mostly based on a seed, appending some unique content.
